식다.m: to cool down, to get cold
식다.ex: 커피가 다 식기 전에 빨리 드세요.
식다.x: Drink your coffee quickly before it gets cold.
식다.e: Also used for feelings: 사랑이 식다 'love cools off'.

목숨.x: Firefighters risk their lives to save people.
목숨.e: Probably 목 'throat' + 숨 'breath' — the breath of life.
목숨.t: 목숨을 걸다 'to risk one's life' is the most common collocation.

망가지다.m: to break, to get broken, to be ruined
망가지다.x: My phone fell on the floor and broke.
망가지다.e: Its transitive partner is 망가뜨리다 'to break something'.
망가지다.t: 고장 나다 is mainly for machines; 망가지다 also works for toys, plans, or even health.

특수.x: These clothes are made from a special material.

통일.ex: 많은 사람들이 남북 통일을 바라고 있어요.
통일.x: Many people hope for the reunification of North and South Korea.

응원.ex: 여러분의 응원 덕분에 경기에서 이길 수 있었어요.
응원.x: Thanks to your support, we were able to win the game.
응원.t: 응원할게요! = I'm rooting for you! — a common friendly encouragement.

상쾌하다.x: I feel refreshed after taking a walk in the morning.

경계.x: This river is the boundary between the two cities.
경계.e: Homonym warning: another 경계 means 'caution, alert', as in 경계하다.

신뢰성.x: These survey results are highly reliable.
신뢰성.e: Literally 'the quality of being trusted and relied on.'
신뢰성.t: Pronounced [실뢰썽] — ㄴ before ㄹ turns into ㄹ.

전염병.ex: 전염병을 막으려면 손을 자주 씻어야 합니다.
전염병.x: To prevent infectious diseases, you should wash your hands often.
전염병.e: Literally 'passed-on staining disease' — it spreads like dye.

신재생 에너지.ex: 정부는 신재생 에너지 사용을 늘리려고 해요.
신재생 에너지.x: The government wants to increase the use of renewable energy.
신재생 에너지.e: 신 'new' plus 재생 'renewable', covering both new and renewable sources.

법규.ex: 운전할 때는 교통 법규를 꼭 지켜야 해요.
법규.x: When you drive, you must obey the traffic laws.
법규.t: Most common in 교통 법규 'traffic laws', paired with 지키다 'obey' or 위반하다 'violate'.

격차.ex: 도시와 농촌의 소득 격차가 점점 커지고 있습니다.
격차.x: The income gap between cities and rural areas keeps widening.
격차.e: Literally 'a difference in rank or level.'

속이 시원하다.forms: 속이 시원해요 · 속이 다 시원하네요 · 속 시원한 (+noun)
속이 시원하다.m: to feel relieved, to feel a weight off one's chest (lit. the inside feels cool)
속이 시원하다.ex: 하고 싶던 말을 다 하니까 속이 시원해요.
속이 시원하다.x: Now that I've said everything I wanted to say, I feel so relieved.
속이 시원하다.e: 속 'inside, gut' is where frustration is felt; when it clears, the inside feels cool and fresh.
속이 시원하다.t: Also for satisfying news or a well-deserved outcome: 속 시원한 결말 'a satisfying ending'. Opposite feeling: 속이 답답하다.

영토.ex: 두 나라는 작은 섬의 영토 문제로 갈등하고 있습니다.
영토.x: The two countries are in conflict over the territorial issue of a small island.
영토.e: Literally 'governed land'. 영- = held by a state: 영해 waters, 영공 airspace.

동문.m: alumni, fellow graduates (of the same school)
동문.x: I stay in touch with my fellow alumni even after graduating.
동문.e: Literally 'same gate', meaning the same school; beware the homonym meaning 'east gate'.

항암.ex: 삼촌은 지난달부터 항암 치료를 받고 계세요.
항암.x: My uncle has been undergoing chemotherapy since last month.
항암.e: Literally 'fight cancer'. 항- = anti-: 항생제, 항균.
항암.t: Mostly used before another noun: 항암 치료, 항암제, 항암 효과.

호언장담.x: He boldly declared that he would come in first.
호언장담.t: Often used as 호언장담하다, and it usually hints the speaker may not deliver.

득실.m: gains and losses, pros and cons
득실.ex: 결정하기 전에 득실을 잘 따져 봐야 해요.
득실.x: You need to weigh the gains and losses carefully before deciding.
득실.t: Pronounced [득씰]; usually with 따지다 or 계산하다: 득실을 따지다, 'to weigh the pros and cons.'

구속영장.x: The court issued an arrest warrant, citing the seriousness of the crime.
구속영장.e: Literally 'a document ordering someone held and bound'.
구속영장.t: Prosecutors 구속영장을 청구하다 'request a warrant'; the court 발부하다 'issues' or 기각하다 'rejects' it.

성찰.ex: 일기를 쓰면 하루를 성찰하는 데 도움이 돼요.
성찰.x: Keeping a diary helps you reflect on your day.
성찰.t: 성찰 is deeper and more philosophical than 반성, which usually implies regret over a mistake.

광자.ex: 빛은 광자라는 작은 입자로 이루어져 있어요.
광자.x: Light is made up of tiny particles called photons.
광자.t: -자 = particle: 광자, 전자 (electron), 양성자, 중성자, 입자.

동위원소.ex: 과학자들은 탄소 동위원소로 화석의 나이를 알아냅니다.
동위원소.x: Scientists determine the age of fossils using carbon isotopes.
동위원소.e: Literally 'same-position element' — same spot on the periodic table.

복호화.ex: 암호화된 파일은 비밀번호가 있어야 복호화할 수 있어요.
복호화.x: An encrypted file can be decrypted only with the password.
복호화.e: Literally 'turning a code back' — the reverse of 암호화.
복호화.t: Pronounced [보코화] — ㄱ and ㅎ merge into ㅋ.

상회하다.m: to exceed, to be above (a figure)
상회하다.x: This year's sales far exceeded expectations.
상회하다.e: Literally 'go around above' — running higher than a mark.
상회하다.t: A news word for numbers; the native synonym is 웃돌다.

확산되다.ex: 그 소문은 인터넷을 통해 빠르게 확산되었습니다.
확산되다.x: The rumor spread quickly through the internet.
확산되다.t: Typical in news about diseases, rumors and trends: 감염이 확산되다 'infections spread'.
